chatpage.intro1: Quick explanation of how this page works.
chatpage.intro2: It's structured around groups of chats with the same character. To the left is where you can set the character's information. To the right is where you can set the chat's information you can't open it until you have a chat selected though.
chatpage.intro3: Above is where you can switch between chats. Clicking the plus icon will create a new one. This message will disappear once you do. The button next to it exports your current chats as a json file. You can import that file on the previous screen instead of clicking new. Nothing is saved automatically so export regularly. Downloaded files are timestamped, so you can use that to keep track of which is newest.
chatpage.intro4: Once you have a chat selected you'll see a pair of input fields at the bottom, the one on the right is for the user, the one on the left is for the contact. You can use the tab key to switch between them.
chatpage.intro5: Hitting enter in either will send the message. Shift+enter will create a new line.
chatpage.intro6: The emoji next to the contact input will change the emotion that gets added to messages you send from that input. The lock icon next to it will make it so that generations use that emotion instead of trying to generate one as part of the message.
chatpage.intro7: Once you've sent a message you can click on it to edit it. You can also click on the emoji next to the message to change the emotion tied to it.
chatpage.intro8: If you click into the pronoun field you can write customized pronouns if needed.
chatpage.intro9: Oh yeah, you change the user name by clicking on it above the user input. It doesn't look like you can edit it, I know, but you can.

contextSettings.insertionOrderTooltip:
Entries are ordered by their insertion order before context is built. Entries with higher insertion order will reserve tokens and be inserted into the context first. 
If two entries share the same insertion order there is no guarantee which will be inserted first.
contextSettings.insertionPositionTooltip:
The location the entry will be inserted into the context. 0 is the very top of the context, 1 is one unit down, 2 is two units down etc. 
Negative numbers will count from the bottom of the context starting with -1 at the very bottom, making -2 one unit up, -3 two units up etc.
contextSettings.insertionTypeTooltip: Determines what units will be used to separate the context when inserting entries.
contextSettings.maximumTrimTypeTooltip: The extent to which the entry is allowed to be trimmed in the order newline > sentence > token.
contextSettings.prefixTooltip: Text prepended to the entry after trimming and before inserting it into context.
contextSettings.reservedTokensTooltip:
The number of tokens of the context the entry may reserve for itself. All reservations are made before any entries are placed in context. It will not reserve more tokens than the entry actually contains. 
Decimal numbers between 0 and 1 (inclusive) will be interpreted as a percentage of the maximum context size (max tokens - output length).
contextSettings.suffixTooltip: Text appended to the entry after trimming and before inserting it into context.
contextSettings.tokenBudgetTooltip:
The maximum amount of tokens of the context the entry may use. 
Decimal numbers between 0 and 1 (inclusive) will be interpreted as a percentage of the maximum context size (max tokens - output length).
contextSettings.trimDirectionTooltip:
The direction the entry will be trimmed from when the entire entry will not fit in the context. 
If set to 'Do Not Trim' the entry will only be included if the entirety of its text will fit within the context.

lorebook.keyRelativeInsertionTooltip:
Causes the Lorebook entry to be inserted relative to the last of its keys to be found within the context. 
Positive Insertion positions will insert the entry after the key. Negative insertion positions will insert the entry before the key. 
A key is not guaranteed to be found within the context, in these cases the entry will not be included. 
Entries with this setting enabled should typically have a lower Insertion Order than the story context (default 0) and a sufficient amount of reserved tokens. 
 Large numbers of relatively inserted lorebook entries can slow down context creation.

stories.storyStart.storytellerPreview.1: You are a wizened wizard of old. Comfortably seated in your most glorious of thrones, your eyes are focused on the curvature of the perfect object before you. This is your favorite past-time and your true purpose - to ponder. With a glazed stare, you watch and ponder what you see in the orb:
stories.storyStart.storytellerPreview.2: scenes of various natural settings from around the world, but also scenes of war and destruction. There are otherworldly scenes such as glowing orbs and strange beings and even representations of things that don't quite seem possible. The orb seems to change the more time you spend staring into it. As you ponder the many wondrous sights, you grow older and wearier each day. But there are always new wonders to be seen and marveled over. As you look deeper into the orb, you see new places in the distance and begin to wonder if perhaps this is truly another universe hidden beyond the stars. The orb itself seems to grow brighter as you ponder, and then dims slightly when you turn away to take a break. Each time you gaze at it, you feel the need to return to your throne and continue contemplating. Eventually the orb begins to glow bright again, and you must return to contemplate once more.

Describe your panel layout, characters, and composition in natural language, and V5 generates the entire page at once.

v5Landing.faq.0.a: No, V4.5 is still available to use.

v5Landing.faq.2.a: They’re not part of the current launch but are planned as post-launch additions for V5, consistent with how we’ve rolled out past model generation additions.
v5Landing.faq.2.q: What happened to Vibe Transfer, and Precise Reference?
v5Landing.faq.3.a: English and Japanese are officially supported. Chinese, German, Spanish, and Portuguese have shown usable results in testing but weren’t a primary training focus, so results may be less consistent.

v5Landing.lead: Sharper natural language understanding. Expanded multi-language prompting. Reworked character positioning. Higher image fidelity. This is the most advanced model we’ve ever shipped.

v5Landing.startCreatingNote: Both V5 Curated and V5 Full are available today
v5Landing.textRenderingSub.0:
V5 renders text in multiple languages, and it’s easier to trigger than ever. Just quote your text and the frontend automatically builds the “Text:” block for you (previously a manual step in V4.5).
Prefer to hand-build it yourself? That’s still fully supported.
v5Landing.textRenderingTagline: Now supports up to 750 characters of text.
v5Landing.title:
NovelAI Diffusion V5
The #1 AI Anime Image Generator
v5Landing.whatsDifferentSub:
V5 isn’t a big deal because of any single feature. It’s a big deal because of how all of them work together.
Better prompt understanding means better compositions. A better VAE means cleaner details and cleaner alpha transparency. And better character positioning means comic generation actually works the way you’d want it to. Every upgrade compounds the others; this is the most refined, most capable model we’ve built.
vtLanding.checkOutVibeTransfer: Check out how Vibe Transfer unlocks new ways to express your vision -- scroll down to explore everything it can do.
vtLanding.howItWorksSub.0: Alongside your existing generation or prompt, easily upload a reference image (or multiple!) and Vibe Transfer will extract and fuse the aesthetics into a singular, stunning work of art.
vtLanding.lead: Effortlessly blend the mood, style, and energy of multiple images to create a truly unique masterpiece.
vtLanding.multivibeSub: Unlock limitless creative possibilities and blend up to 16 art styles within a single image to make your art truly unique.
vtLanding.settingsSub: Easily adjust the amount of the source image used and the strength of the Vibe Transfer applied. Increase the amount to pull in more elements, or decrease to exclude.
vtLanding.vibeDownloadingSub: Preserve your art style by downloading the  “.naiv4vibe” file, which stores your Vibe Transfer data. You can then import the file into your images or share it with friends to easily replicate your unique aesthetic.
vtLanding.vibeEncodingSub: Vibe Encoding in V4 has been significantly enhanced to process higher level details with higher fidelity from your source images.
vtLanding.vibesInImageMetadataSub: Encoded vibes can now be embedded in your image’s metadata, making it easy to replicate and share your previous setups.
vtLanding.whatIsVibeTransferSub.1: is a feature only available on NovelAI giving you the freedom to blend the mood, color, texture, and style of multiple images into one seamless, custom look -- no advanced editing skills needed!  This powerful tool goes beyond basic style transfer and gives you full creative control over the vibe of your AI image generations.
vtLanding.whyItsDifferentSub.0: Unlike a traditional style transfer, Vibe Transfer goes beyond surface-level looks. It's about setting a tone -- pulling together atmosphere, color stories, and emotional textures into a powerful, unified work of art.
vtLanding.whyItsDifferentSub.1: Ready to vibe? Log in now to explore Vibe Transfer in action.
